query: I can't remember the password for the admissions website. What now?
answer: To change your admission password, follow these steps: Go to https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/login Login your credentials and proceed to your dashboard click your Profile icon to view the choices logout or My Account, and choose My Account you can now change your password by just clicking the Change Password button
notes: ["Different ID; review possible equivalent records before treating this as a bug."]
